q: A valid token is sent but lacks the needed permission. Which status?
why: 401 = not authenticated (no/bad token); 403 = authenticated but not allowed.

q: A shared X-Password header proves which user is calling.
why: Myth. Everyone shares it; it identifies no user, can't carry permissions and leaks easily.
